text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A racing outfit.
It is formal attire imbued with an
Umamusume's dedication to the race—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And the indispensable flowers that bloom
upon the runway of the racetrack.
A fashion show to showcase once again the
allure of these racing silks—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Titled 'TORECEN GIRLS COLLECTION', we are
now underway!
Serving as your host is none other than
myself, North Flight."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A festival of Racewear brought to you by
Umamusume, featuring top contenders from
the Twinkle Series! We'll be bringing you
full, in-depth coverage of "TCGC"!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
First off, first off! Walking like a
runway model!!
Walking like a model... C-Can I really do
this?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, shut up, like I care!!
Well... as long as I walk around lookin'
the part, it'll be fine, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"You thinking 'like a model' is easy or
something? City's walk is seriously out of
this world, y'know?!
—No joke, she's amazing. There's no way
normal folks could pull that off..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Everyone seems rattled by this
unfamiliar situation.
However—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(To be personally invited to appear in
such an important event...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First, let us have you show off your
Racing Outfits on the runway!
Contestant Number 1, Duramente-san, if you
please.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I will certainly see it through.
Like a model—gracefully, perfectly—!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
T-This is...! That 'signature' walk that
Duramente
often shows before a race--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! She was doing that exact same thing
when I went to watch her race before!
Haha, she's really fired up.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The chic color scheme of monochrome and
gold brings out 'elegance,' while the
striking accent color exudes
'strength'—what a racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...I blew it.
I let Sis Groove down...)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Insaaaane~! The crowd's going absolutely
wild, isn't it!?
Doing all this just by walking,
Duramente-chan is crazy awesome~

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks to that, we figured out loud
and clear
that 'that's how' we oughta do it too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"It ain't about walkin' 'like a model'...
It's about walkin' 'like ourselves'!!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wooooooo!! Hey, all of you!!
Burn the sight of my racing outfit into
your retinas!!!

text_block_list.name: Underlings
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!! Pokke-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The asymmetrical silhouette and relaxed
footwear
create an unpretentious, unconventional
lightness, while—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The color scheme and the animal print
accent are so wild!
Fufu, both the design and the styling suit
you perfectly, Pokke-chan."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What are you doing, Pocket...!!
Wait, is it fine? Everyone seems pretty
hyped up, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see! So basically... I just need to hype
things up in my own style!
If that's the case—alriiiiiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: TOOOOOOOHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wow, such nimble movement! It really shows
off that it's a racing outfit
combining sportiness with functional
beauty...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I have no idea what's goin' on anymore,
but...
It'd be totally lame not to ride the
wave!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta show off the nails first, tho.
Waaaay♪ Waaaay♪ Waaaay♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mesh, zippers, glitter, aurora hues...
Mixing all these different materials while
keeping it totally pop and trendy—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, look at those nails designed
to perfectly match the outfit!
This Racing attire truly shows dedication
'down to the tips of her nails'!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
As expected of our fashion queen!! You
totally get it~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What wonderful excitement! Though the
atmosphere is quite different
from the fashion shows I have seen
before...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A racing outfit is attire designed to make
each Umamusume's unique individuality
shine at its most captivating—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's why I think this show—with "Racing
Outfits" as its theme—
is the perfect fit for an atmosphere
bursting with such distinct personalities♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...Indeed, everyone else is demonstrating
their individuality.
Yet I... simply made a mistake—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"......Don't make that face.
That too is a fine 'individuality' of
yours, is it not?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Prone to tension and easily stiffened. Yet
overflowing with a fighting spirit and
sincerity
that more than make up for it... That is
your way of walking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The fans and I appreciate that
'individuality' of yours—
Stop looking down. The show is still
going, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —! Yes, Sister Groove.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For the final appeal, it's posing &
passion!
Strike your best pose and tell us what
your racewear means to you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To me, my Racewear is a partner chasing
dreams alongside me!!
Whenever I wear it, my heart pounds with
excitement and it gives me strength!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
To me, a racing outfit is... combat gear!
I'm throwin' down in this—till I take the
title of the strongest!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This racer outfit, my nails—I designed
every single bit of it for real-real, and
it's my absolute fave—so basically, it's
my pure, unadulterated dedication made
real, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To me, my racing outfit is my pride.
It must be attire worthy of the
"strongest." Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I modeled it after the racing outfit of
Big Sis Groove, whom I deeply respect.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I told you to stop calling me that in
front of everyone... Good grief.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for the wonderful racing
racewear and lovely sentiments!
Fufu, it makes me want to run in my own
racewear as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, please make sure I'm
the first one to interview you...!
